name: dorm-mart
_comment_homepage: homepage specifiation allows routing to the project files from server root

scripts._commint_start-local: used to enforce locally running react to load .env.development
scripts._comment_build-local: used to build local server app
scripts.build-local-mac: env-cmd -f .env.local bash -c 'echo Using $REACT_APP_API_BASE && GENERATE_SOURCEMAP=false react-scripts build'
scripts._comment_build-prod: used to build prod server app
scripts.build-prod-mac: env-cmd -f .env.production bash -c 'echo Building prod && GENERATE_SOURCEMAP=false react-scripts build'
scripts.build-cattle-mac: env-cmd -f .env.cattle bash -c 'echo Building prod && GENERATE_SOURCEMAP=false react-scripts build'
scripts.test:backend: php api/tests/adversarial_validation_test.php && php api/tests/login_location_test.php && php api/tests/promotional_digest_test.php

_comment_overrides: react-scripts 5.0.1 is frozen and pins vulnerable transitive packages; these swap in patched, API-compatible versions
_comment_proxy: used to connect local react to locally running php server
